Xiao Huangqi’s Golden Melody Nomination Portrait

Xiao Huangqi in Gradient Suit

Xiao Huangqi, the Taiwanese singer-songwriter famed for "You Are My Eyes," poses in a bold green and blue gradient suit with black sunglasses. His arms are crossed, and he gazes forward with a calm, confident expression against a plain background.

This promotional portrait precedes his first solo concert on the U.S. West Coast, scheduled for August 9, 2025, at Yaamava’ Resort & Casino in Highland, California. The event celebrates his 20th anniversary in music and features special guest Wan Fang. source.title: ‎沒事的 - 蕭煌奇的專輯 - Apple Music
source.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s “No Worries” Album Cover

Ricky Hsiao’s 2024 album “No Worries” (沒事的) presents a minimalist portrait of the singer with his eyes closed, framed by two hands pressing gently on his cheeks. The dark backdrop highlights the teal typography spelling out “RICKY HSIAO” at the top and “NO WORRIES” at the bottom, while the Chinese characters 蕭煌奇 and 沒事的 appear on either side.

Released on Apple Music, the album comprises 10 tracks totaling 42 minutes. The bilingual title and serene imagery reflect the album’s message of reassurance and calm, inviting listeners to embrace a worry-free mindset.

source.description:
Singer Xiao Huangqi stands against a white backdrop in a striking rainbow-hued shirt and paisley tie, topped off with sleek black sunglasses. His loose, wavy hair frames a confident expression, while the gradient colors of his outfit—from warm yellows and pinks to cool blues and purples—underscore his bold style.

This image illustrates the artist’s dynamic persona, captured during promotional coverage for his theme song “默聲” from the crime action film "器子." The vivid attire and composed pose reflect both his musical versatility and his ability to embody the emotional depth of the film’s lead character.
